thought: She was a homemaker in Odisha who noticed fish farming on a reservoir - and decided to learn the trade herself.
support: Sujata Bhuyan, from Sambalpur district, Odisha, was a homemaker with no business background when she observed cage-culture fish farming at the Hirakud Reservoir in 2022. She completed structured training through the Odisha Department of Fisheries, took a bank loan, and launched her own reservoir cage-culture operation. She earned roughly Rs 6 lakh in her first year, scaling to Rs 7-10 lakh annually within 2-3 years, now producing 25-30 metric tonnes of fish a year and supplying markets across Odisha, Andhra Pradesh, Chhattisgarh and West Bengal. PM Modi cited her as a model of grassroots entrepreneurship in the 132nd episode of Mann Ki Baat on March 29, 2026. From watching a reservoir to running a 25-tonne-a-year business - entirely self-taught, one training course at a time.
